e0fb40ceb42cdb91cc733b99fa69d29172965643.text: These bowls have been cold for three hundred years. Let them remember.

b200d32e47fcca670ba3075bc3546a8940ac3633.text: Stand still. I would rather look you in the eye.

07f6426af89f025117e3c1cffc6d51f7f7352f80.text: There. Easier to talk like this, is it not?

32ebd388dda9746162e18ac590ba0a7a38bd9ced.text: Keep the circle warm, little mage. I will know if you let it sleep.

a7a4caf7c5ad78f7d9697e74708ccf5872f7b83a.text: So. You are the one who woke the old circle. I felt it from the summit, like a hearth relit.

2d0cf8668ab210965498ac598d02df1ac01df190.text: Two of you. Good. A circle wakes faster with two voices, and every Keeper's hearth was lit from one flame. Mine.

89ad2e8bdcb1ecb33f11e4c5a32fe1f863034709.text: I watched your wind. It curls, like a leaf in an updraft. Keep that. A straight wind is a dead wind.

f496960fb56c78becf0574056f638421d9f4650c.text: Three beats when it was whole. The third was mine, the hearth-fire's. The Circle carried it south when they left, and the stone has counted two ever since.

ce9a4b1c8bfc1f5052c4282f73afbbee1b39ca48.text: Every Keeper's hearth was lit from one flame. Mine. A circle answers the flame's memory before it answers any word.

4252b293848f1d876021a9e2f802ba9c63ddc40f.text: The summit keeps my fire; I keep the summit's memory. Earn the climb, and ask me what you like.

6f5d9eafbc1426f9712d643753afcc59535827e4.text: Keep the circle warm. It forgets quickly, and it is not the only thing in these woods that listens.
